name: Vuzsa
description: Vuzsa was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Arkanis sector. It served as a refueling point for starships traveling along the Trans Gulf Route hyperlane. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a safehouse at Vuzsa, at which the Rebel agent Tiree once hid in order to evade capture by the Galactic Empire.
